verdict.rationale: Render is a cloud platform with a REST API and workflow tasks, so documented rate limits and concurrency caps are a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack documents API rate limits or concurrency caps for functions or tasks. The autoscaling claims and the REST API/OpenAPI listing are adjacent and do not state any limits.

support.subject: As a developer, I know the documented rate limits and concurrency caps for APIs and functions so I can plan for scale
